summary: Implement parallel shifted-exponential and normalization passes and connect them to the complete softmax forward pipeline. Preserve all numerical outcomes, derive admission and existence separately, and audit every added public declaration.

examined.reason: The audit still verifies pinned dependencies, exact public declarations and source immutability; added modules and fresh checks extend coverage without changing assurance claims.
Parallel elementwise launches now compose with the unchanged reductions and preserve exactly the reference output arrays; accuracy and existence remain distinct.

Arithmetic contracts remain unchanged. Updated enclosing-pipeline quotations and removed a stale statement that memory-connected execution is still unimplemented; the scalar interface now explicitly delegates it to forward execution.
All forward arithmetic passes now have parallel execution; summary and outstanding scope preserve phase/runtime, masking and backward boundaries.
New responsibility documents actual parallel fetch, explicit entry pointers, graph-derived operands, universal stores, witness construction and exact reference-output equivalence.
The existing attained finite maximum, exact global frame and independent admitted launch witness are reused unchanged.
The four-instruction scalar relation, bounded input domain and all-outcome approximation remain unchanged; the parallel adapter reuses these leaves.
The example hierarchy still requires explicit input/numerical/execution coverage and reproducible verification; the softmax extension follows those promises.
Parallel scheduling preserves the exact allowed output arrays and the existing error guard; no precision policy, accuracy bound or backward claim changes.
The same conservative two-policy exponential envelope and rounded reciprocal are preserved, with no hardware conformance or unique-output claim.
The unchanged dense launch supplies the unit-weight summation reduction with its existing ordering, allocation and all-execution result. The new adapter does not alter that machine.
The unchanged rcp.rn.f32 Eval relation is lifted into the parallel adapter with the stronger common target threshold; all original rounding and exceptional outcomes remain represented.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; python3 integration/torchlean/check.py; stratic validate; independent proof and semantic review of the parallel adapter, admission, output equivalence and accuracy interfaces
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0; 16 checked pinned integration dependencies; Linux; no GPU execution or external model API calls
results.evidence: Root suite passed with 1643 exact dependency reports. Integration suite passed on 244 Lean source files with 2373 exact dependency reports, permitting only standard Lean axioms; all 171 new public declarations included. Fresh regression elaboration covers wrong candidate admission rejection, a genuine two-lane read interleaving and universal/inhabited singleton exactness. Independent reviewers found no blocking issue. Stratic descriptions and links validate. Proposed snapshot identical before and after checks.
